yaml-comments.summary: The separate character scanner mistakes scalar data for comments and vice versa.
yaml-comments.fix: Remove only the lexer's actual comment-token spans. Add block-scalar and plain-apostrophe regressions; supply the upstream-bug evidence for central deviation recording.

yaml-typeof.summary: A concrete native-runtime gate miss in value equality.
yaml-typeof.fix: Delete the redundant typeof-versus-typeof check, preserving equality cases.

node-guards.summary: Value extraction and navigation repeatedly construct guards instead of reusing them.
node-guards.fix: Derive Scalar/Map/Seq/Alias guards once after the class declarations and reuse them in toValue, findByPath, pathToNode and offset navigation; retain schema-backed semantics and repeat the reported benchmark.

node-literal-kits.summary: Named node/style domains have not received the mandatory LiteralKit modeling pass; green gates did not cover it.
node-literal-kits.fix: Use equivalently annotated LiteralKit values with the same literals, value names and derived type names.

node-identity.summary: The public union lacks its composer-derived schema identity.
node-identity.fix: Apply $I.annoteSchema("YamlNode", { description: ... }) to the suspended union, retaining its recursive codec type.

alias-error.summary: The cross-module error violates the required schema-backed error contract.
alias-error.fix: Define an identity/field-annotated S.TaggedError preserving the tag, message, name and upstream positional constructor behavior where lawful; update construction and Yaml.ts catches to hoisted schema guards. Pin catchability and budget messages in tests; central codemod records any forced shape change.

anchor-boundary.summary: The Effect wrapper is discarded and a public native anchor collection remains.
anchor-boundary.fix: Return and pass MutableHashMap values through buildAnchorMap, getNodeValue, nodeToJsValue and every node toValue implementation; replace native has/get/set with Effect operations and test sequential duplicate-anchor resolution. The g1 state fix and allow-2/allow-3 complete the same migration; remove the unforced getNodeValue dual rather than retaining its Map predicate.

composer-map-state.summary: Two separate composer structures still use native maps through an implementation-field escape.
composer-map-state.fix: Store MutableHashMap in ComposerState.anchors and tagMap, retain wrappers in createState, use MutableHashMap.has/set/get in anchors.ts and tags.ts, and unwrap lookup Options explicitly. Keep the document.ts tag-registration site assigned to composer-tag-registration (g4); coordinate both groups in one fix wave.

anchor-guards.summary: Collecting anchors rebuilds schema guards for each AST node.
anchor-guards.fix: Hoist the schema-derived guards locally and reuse them; preserve collected anchors and extraction results.

state-model.summary: The mutable metadata payload is not derived from a schema.
state-model.fix: Define an annotated structural schema and derive NodeMeta, retaining optional and writable keys. Leave the callable FlowComposers contract alone.

state-option-spreads.summary: Redundant Option/record allocations at each node rebuild.
state-option-spreads.fix: Consolidate the three optional comment fields into one getSomesStruct call with identical omission behavior.

restore-composer-core.summary: Unforced callable shape and dispatch changes in the core composer helpers.
restore-composer-core.fix: Restore the pinned oracle's plain function signatures/defaults and bodies in anchors.ts, state.ts and tags.ts, retaining required native-runtime/schema changes. Restore any upstream test lines changed solely for these new curried forms; use the g1-owned core regression test.

format-nonfinite-error.summary: A law-forced representation change broke typed failure construction; this is substantive, not deviation bookkeeping.
format-nonfinite-error.fix: Keep finite numeric schemas. Add an annotated tagged non-finite-index representation with a LiteralKit kind (NaN/PositiveInfinity/NegativeInfinity); normalize only echoed error paths to that representation before every error.make and include it in the path schema. Render these tags as their original numeric spelling. Add NaN/±Infinity failure/catchTag regressions; do not restore unrestricted S.Number or weaken schema-number.

format-guards.summary: Measured constant-factor regression in formatting and modification walks.
format-guards.fix: Derive Scalar/Map/Seq guards once at module scope in YamlFormat.ts and use them in recursive functions and callbacks; repeat the reported probes.

modify-error-schema.summary: The navigation failure model violates the typed-error law.
modify-error-schema.fix: Use an annotated S.TaggedError with a named LiteralKit code domain and finite offset/length fields; preserve its message/codes, update construction and use a hoisted schema guard at the catch.

edit-sort.summary: Edit application uses explicitly forbidden native sorting despite green gates.
edit-sort.fix: Use A.sort with reverse numeric offset Order and preserve stable ties and the non-mutating input contract.

restore-render-helpers.summary: Unforced signatures and dispatch regress from the pinned oracle.
restore-render-helpers.fix: Restore all eight upstream plain function signatures, optional parameters/defaults and bodies in fold/diff/equal/requote, retaining diagnostic- or law-required substitutions. Restore any upstream test lines rewritten for their added data-last shape; add optional-argument regressions.

fold-newline.summary: A more-indented-to-normal transition corrupts scalar content.
fold-newline.fix: Add !prevMoreIndented to the compensation-blank-line condition; pin the failing value round trip and supply the verified upstream-bug evidence.

fold-boolean-iifes.summary: Trivial allocated wrapper lambdas violate the tersest equivalent helper form.

fold-error-identity.summary: The error schema's required identity/field annotations are incomplete.
fold-error-identity.fix: If FoldFailure remains after the local fix, add meaningful $I.annote and message.annotateKey metadata without changing tag/message; do not remove guards just to satisfy coverage.

equal-typeof.summary: A concrete native-runtime scanner miss remains even in an unused upstream file.
equal-typeof.fix: Delete the redundant typeof comparison. Retain the upstream module/export under D2.

restore-stringifier-api.summary: Unforced dual APIs introduce ambiguous/shadowed overloads and duck dispatch.
restore-stringifier-api.fix: Restore plain data-first stringifyValue(value, options?), stringifyDocument(doc, options?) and renderDoubleQuoted(s, canonical=false) from the pinned oracle, retaining required body changes. Restore any test lines rewritten for new curried forms.

stringifier-bigint.fix: Before string/fallback branches, handle P.isBigInt and emit preserved numeric spelling or the bigint string without quotes. Add root/map/sequence document round-trip regressions.

stringifier-depth.summary: Canonical preprocessing bypasses the nesting-depth guarantee.
stringifier-depth.fix: Thread a depth counter into stripNodeComments and throw StringifyDepthExceeded at MAX_NESTING_DEPTH before descending. Add canonical preprocessing depth regressions.

stringifier-errors.summary: Cross-module errors lack required schema identities; invariant metadata is incomplete.
stringifier-errors.fix: Use identity/field-annotated S.TaggedError classes, preserving reason/message/name and upstream construction semantics where lawful; annotate StringifierInvariantFailure. Use .make at internal construction sites as required. The public facade catch migration is stringify-error-catches (g1), not an extra source owner here.

stringifier-sort.summary: Value and AST renderers still execute forbidden native sorts.
stringifier-sort.fix: Use A.sort with Order.String and equivalent mapInput Order for pairs; preserve key coercion, non-scalar fallback and stable ties.

stringifier-dispatch.summary: Per-scalar matcher allocation causes a measured 2.5–3.5x public stringification regression.
stringifier-dispatch.fix: Build the style dispatch once at module scope (handlers accept a record carrying dynamic scalar/context arguments), or use an equivalent schema/data dispatch table; avoid rebuilding Match and its closures for each scalar. Verify byte parity and repeat the seat benchmark. A measured if-chain tradeoff must cite this evidence if chosen.

stringifier-indicators.summary: A measured membership regression affects every plain scalar/key.
stringifier-indicators.fix: Represent the same indicator characters once as a string and use effect/String includes, handling the empty first character explicitly so empty-string membership cannot change semantics.

stringifier-guards.summary: Repeated schema guard factories inflate every AST walk.
stringifier-guards.fix: Hoist the four class guards once in stringifier.ts and reuse them throughout rendering, tag normalization and comment stripping; retain schema-derived semantics.

stringify-error-catches.summary: Facade error handlers must remain typed and catch the migrated errors in the same fix wave.
stringify-error-catches.fix: Hoist S.is guards for the migrated stringifier error classes and replace their instanceof catch tests in Yaml.ts/YamlDocument.ts; retain reason/message and fatal-diagnostic mappings.

restore-composer-walks.summary: The composer walk helpers acquired unforced API changes and measurable dispatch cost.
restore-composer-walks.fix: Restore plain upstream function declarations/defaults throughout these five files, retaining law/diagnostic-required body changes and injected FlowComposers seams forced by import-cycle diagnostics. Restore upstream tests rewritten only for the added currying; add resolveScalar two/three-argument regressions. No checker/config edits belong to this group.

composer-tag-registration.summary: Directive registration still uses native collection methods.
composer-tag-registration.fix: Replace this registration site with MutableHashMap.set, coordinated with composer-map-state's tagMap schema/type/initializer and tags.ts lookups. Add directive-resolution regression coverage in this group's test.

composer-verbatim-indent.summary: findParentIndent interprets a tag URI colon as a mapping delimiter and discards block content.
composer-verbatim-indent.fix: Skip tag/property spans in backward structural-colon/sequence-indicator search; add the verbatim-tag block-scalar regression.

flow-missing-comma.summary: Malformed flow maps are accepted with invented keys.
flow-missing-comma.fix: Detect a second structural separator inside a populated comma-delimited entry, keeping nested collection separators scoped; pin rejection without rejecting valid nested/quoted scalar colons.

flow-continuations.summary: Valid multiline scalar fragments are counted as separate flow entries.
flow-continuations.fix: Use the scalar collector's continuation boundaries to count a folded scalar once, retaining genuine missing-comma rejection; add both map/implicit-sequence regressions.

tag-percent-decoding.summary: Equivalent shorthand suffix encodings resolve differently.
tag-percent-decoding.fix: Safely percent-decode the suffix before concatenating its prefix, including the default secondary handle; return positioned composer diagnostics for malformed encodings. Add equivalence/malformed regressions in the g1-owned core test.

directive-validation.fix: Validate YAML version-token grammar and exactly two TAG parameters; emit positioned InvalidDirective diagnostics and add the three regressions.

composer-guards.summary: Every parse/format/lint rebuilds schema guards during composition.
composer-guards.fix: Derive module-local class guards once in comments.ts/document.ts and reuse them in all node walks and rebuilds; preserve behavior and rerun reported measurements.

composer-option-spreads.summary: Multiple redundant Option/record passes per construction.
composer-option-spreads.fix: Consolidate optional fields into one getSomesStruct per construction in these four files; preserve omission and class field values. State's separate commentProps site is state-option-spreads.

composer-schema-alias.summary: Canonical Schema namespace aliases are violated.
composer-schema-alias.fix: Rename imports and references to S in these two files, coordinating guard hoisting.

composer-payload-models.summary: Payload types cannot supply derived guards/annotations from one schema source.
composer-payload-models.fix: Use annotated structural schemas and derive the three types; preserve mutable keys, optionality and existing field representations. NodeMeta is separately owned by state-model.

semantic-item-model.summary: Impossible combinations are representable in the semantic composition stream.
semantic-item-model.fix: Define an annotated discriminated schema union using existing kind values; retain intentional node-less explicit-key markers and empty-value behavior. Adjust block/flow producers and consumers locally to the derived type.

block-guards.summary: Repeated guard construction in key checks contributes to measured composition overhead.
block-guards.fix: Hoist and reuse schema-derived Scalar/Map/Seq guards locally in block.ts; retain key identities and duplicate-key outcomes.

lint-native-sort.summary: Vote/floor normalization, conflict ordering and diagnostics violate the sort law.
lint-native-sort.fix: Use A.sort and equivalent explicit Orders for every sort, preserving lexicographic rule/dimension/key ties, descending counts and diagnostic position order.

lint-json-codec.summary: The conflict renderer violates the schema JSON serialization standard.
lint-json-codec.fix: Bind a schema JSON codec for the existing string/finite-number/boolean candidate domain and use its synchronous Result encoder; preserve existing JSON spelling and recover safely from codec failure.

lint-object-guard.summary: The equivalent named Effect guard is obscured by a repeated two-call helper expression.
lint-object-guard.fix: Use P.isObjectOrArray at all five sites; preserve arrays/object narrowing and rejection of functions.

lint-severity-kit.summary: A reused severity domain misses the named-literal modeling contract.
lint-severity-kit.fix: Use an annotated LiteralKit with error/warning, preserving the same-name type.

catalog-collection.summary: An internal native collection contract is retained behind unnecessary delegation.
catalog-collection.fix: Export the HashMap directly and use HashMap.get plus explicit Option handling in YamlLint; remove the facade. If retaining any promised catalog iteration, expose the existing ordered catalog separately rather than relying on hash iteration.

token-kind-and-model.summary: Duplicated literal truth and a non-schema internal data model.
token-kind-and-model.fix: Define the kind domain once with an annotated LiteralKit and raw token payload as an annotated S.Struct; derive types and reuse the kind domain in the public token schema. Preserve value/column vs public text/character fields; construct plain typed literals in the lexer without adding per-token validation.

token-cr-positions.summary: Lone-CR line/column and indentation-state handling are wrong in both scanner and promoted tokens.
token-cr-positions.fix: Count lone CR and CRLF once in advance/setPosition and reset applicable line state; build the public token line-start index with the same convention. Add scanner-reset and public-token CR/CRLF regressions.

lexer-trailing-whitespace.summary: Consumed source whitespace is absent from token/CST spans.
lexer-trailing-whitespace.fix: Rewind pos/col by trailing whitespace after determining the trimmed scalar end, letting the next scan emit whitespace separately; retain trimmed scalar values and add EOF source-fidelity regressions.

cst-compact-events.summary: CST visitor swaps key/value classification for compact mappings in sequences.
cst-compact-events.fix: Pass/derive whether the first key is external and initialize expectingKey appropriately, retaining sibling-key behavior; add AST/CST projection regressions.

cst-empty-values.summary: Omitted values shift all subsequent key/value events.
cst-empty-values.fix: Update map walker state from entry boundaries/separators before skipping structural nodes; account for omitted block and flow values and pin both regressions.

visitor-event-schema.summary: The concrete public event vocabulary has no schema source of truth.
visitor-event-schema.fix: Define an identity/field-annotated S.TaggedUnion for the existing shapes; derive YamlVisitorEvent and keep Data.taggedEnum as the constructor/matcher surface for structural equality and names.

cst-error-identity.summary: The identity pass is incomplete for this typed error.
cst-error-identity.fix: Add meaningful $I.annote and message.annotateKey metadata if the error survives, preserving its tag/throwing behavior.

cst-token-dispatch.summary: A kind-to-node-type data mapping is encoded as a long conditional chain.
cst-token-dispatch.fix: Use a typed exhaustive module-level kind-to-node-type table or Match dispatch, retaining every token kind, source span and upstream comment.

lexer-escape-dispatch.summary: Lexer escape data is obscured by repetitive dispatch code outside the scanner's reach.
lexer-escape-dispatch.fix: Hoist simple escape characters into a typed Record/HashMap read with R.get/HashMap.get and dispatch the remaining hex/newline/error logic explicitly; preserve all escape/token semantics.

diagnostic-crlf.summary: A valid source position has a negative column.
diagnostic-crlf.fix: Bound CRLF lookahead by the requested scan limit (i+1 < limit), adding the interior-CRLF position regression.

diagnostic-kits.summary: The exported code vocabulary lacks the required kit surface.
diagnostic-kits.fix: Use annotated LiteralKit values over the existing code lists, retaining members/names/types and the public aggregate error-code union.

numeric-option-metadata.summary: Shared numeric constraints lack mandatory schema identity and reusable-filter metadata.
numeric-option-metadata.fix: Create the file composer, annotate both schemas and both checks with identifier/title/description, retaining predicate messages and abort behavior. Do not substitute safe-integer checks that narrow upstream acceptance.

scalar-role-kit.summary: The named scalar-role domain is outside the required LiteralKit model.
scalar-role-kit.fix: Define annotated LiteralKit ScalarRole and derive its same-name type, preserving all walker literals/signatures.

restore-util-functions.summary: An unused unforced API shape was added without a law/diagnostic cause.
restore-util-functions.fix: Restore upstream plain signatures/defaults/bodies for walkScalars, isScalarContinuationLine, coveringToken, insideScalarSpan and positionAt, retaining forced guard substitutions. Restore any test lines rewritten solely for currying; do not add tests for an API that must be removed.

indent-markers.summary: Prefix matching treats ordinary mapping keys as document markers.
indent-markers.fix: Use marker token kinds or complete marker/legal-boundary checks in shared contentLines; add ---key and ...key regressions for check and infer.

indent-quoted-comment.summary: A regex removes scalar content as if it were a trailing comment.
indent-quoted-comment.fix: Use actual comment spans or last significant separator tokens on the preceding line; pin quoted-key checking/inference regressions.

indent-compact-level.summary: The stack omits structural levels opened after a sequence indicator on one line.
indent-compact-level.fix: Advance the shared check/infer indentation model using the compact mapping's structural column; add equivalent compact/expanded regressions.

rule-option-isolation-a.summary: One bad field erases unrelated valid settings in direct rule.check calls.
rule-option-isolation-a.fix: Read and narrow each known field independently, retaining all valid upstream options/defaults and safe values. Restore any rewritten upstream direct-call test lines; add a valid-field/invalid-sibling regression. D15-forced differences on the invalid field itself are central deviation bookkeeping, not permission to discard valid fields.

rule-options-types-a.summary: Consumers cannot import these schema names as their prescribed decoded types.
rule-options-types-a.fix: Add same-name typeof Schema.Type aliases for both numeric constraints and the five option schemas in these six files. Record additions centrally via exportsAdded; do not hand-edit Port notes.

bom-comment-spacing.summary: A leading BOM is incorrectly treated as preceding line content.
bom-comment-spacing.fix: Exclude a leading BOM from hasContentBefore and pin own-line comment diagnosis/fix behavior.

hyphen-fix-fidelity.summary: A successful spacing edit changes nested collection content.
hyphen-fix-fidelity.fix: Retain the diagnostic but omit its fix when shortening the separator relocates a compact block collection with continuation entries. Keep safe scalar fixes; add sequence/map value-fidelity regressions.

rule-option-isolation-b.summary: An unrelated invalid field erases valid direct-call rule settings.
rule-option-isolation-b.fix: Narrow known fields independently, retaining valid options and defaults without unsafe casts; add independent-field direct-check regressions and restore any rewritten upstream tests. Record only residual D15-forced invalid-field behavior centrally.

rule-options-types-b.summary: These exported non-class schemas omit the required decoded-type API.
rule-options-types-b.fix: Add same-name derived type exports for all five schemas; let the central codemod record added exports.

rule-options-types-c.summary: Their schema-owned decoded-type API is incomplete.
rule-options-types-c.fix: Add the four same-name typeof Schema.Type aliases; central exportsAdded bookkeeping owns the record.

restore-test-harness.summary: The upstream test-helper shape was rewritten without a law or diagnostic requiring currying.
restore-test-harness.fix: Restore the upstream plain two-parameter helper signatures/bodies and all upstream test lines rewritten only for currying; retain assert.isDefined cast removal and YamlLintDiagnostic.make required by diagnostics. Do not treat this restoration as deferred vitest-canon work.

allow-1.summary: The removed native-runtime exception must be eliminated without merging structurally equal distinct values.
allow-1.fix: Replace the ancestor Set with a per-traversal ancestor stack scanned using ===; push/pop on descent/unwind and retain circular-reference failure, shared-reference acceptance and depth behavior. Add cyclic vs structurally equal distinct-object regressions; no byReferenceUnsafe marks.

allow-2.summary: A now-removed exception retains native anchor maps at the facade.
allow-2.fix: Create MutableHashMap anchor maps in every Yaml facade extraction path and pass them to migrated node APIs; preserve encounter-order registration and duplicate-anchor alias semantics. Update the native Map in scratchpad/test/yaml/e2e/support/engine.ts:75 in this group, plus affected core tests.

allow-3.summary: Document extraction still creates a native anchor map under a removed exception.
allow-3.fix: Use MutableHashMap.empty in document toValue/extraction, passing it through the migrated node API; preserve alias registration/resolution semantics and test document extraction.

allow-4.summary: The removed identity-set exception must be replaced without structural equality collisions.
allow-4.fix: Use a replacement-conversion ancestor stack scanned with ===, pushed/popped per recursive descent. Preserve CircularReference handling, accept distinct structurally equal objects and repeated non-ancestor sharing, and add regressions.
